definitions.explanation: The latitude line at about 66.5 degrees south, and by extension the region south of it where the sun stays up or down for a full day at the solstices.

examples.japanese: {南極圏|なんきょくけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧。
examples.english: The cold in the Antarctic region is severe.

examples.japanese: ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{南極圏|なんきょくけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The ship entered the Antarctic Circle.

examples.japanese: {南極圏|なんきょくけん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{沈|しず}まない→沈む：02061_shizumu⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In the Antarctic Circle there can be a run of days in summer when the sun does not set.

notes:
⟦{南極|なんきょく}→南極：11936_nankyoku⟧ (South Pole, Antarctic) + ⟦{圏|けん}→圏：21183_ken⟧ (sphere, zone). The ⟦{圏|けん}→圏：21183_ken⟧ suffix marks a bounded area and appears in many geographic and social terms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {南極圏|なんきょくけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter the Antarctic Circle
- {南極圏|なんきょくけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧: the climate of the Antarctic region
- {南極圏|なんきょくけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{越|こ}える→越える：02099_koeru⟧: to cross the Antarctic Circle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{北極圏|ほっきょくけん}→北極圏：23417_hokkyokuken⟧: Arctic Circle — the matching term in the north
- ⟦{南極大陸|なんきょくたいりく}→南極大陸：30173_nankyokutairiku⟧: the Antarctic continent — the landmass itself, not the latitude zone
